'''Ethen Remak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commando/Legends|Commando]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Separatist War]] against the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the war, he spent time on the island [[Mannett Point]], where he oversaw the excavation of a [[Datacron/Legends|data holocron]] by hostages on one of the island's beaches. He wore the standard [[Color/Legends|brown]] Separatist uniform while on the beach and black and white face [[Painting/Legends|paint]]. He also used a backpack and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. He had black hair and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> while Remak watched over the excavation site, he was attacked and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a individual aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who were backing the Central Authority in the war. This allowed his hostages to escape.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ethen Remak first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game he appeared as low level boss on the Republic world of Ord Mantell, but was not involved in any questline. His death was required however, for the completion of the achievement "Liberator of Ord Mantell" and so this article assumes players killed him as part of one hundred percent game completion.
